summary: Describes Extreme Networks' Ethernet Automatic Protection Switching (EAPS), a technology invented by that company to make Ethernet rings more available and robust. An EAPS ring can be resilient in a way comparable to SONET rings, at lower cost and with fewer limits such as ring size. It is a vendor description, published as informational.

eli5.summary: Kids in a circle pass a ball. If one kid steps out, the ball goes the other way around the circle. This describes a company's trick for keeping network rings working when one link breaks.
